about_the_game:
Become a real driver and experience the most immersive and authentic tram simulation to date in City Transport Simulator: Tram! Drive highly detailed real-world trams, build and customize your own transport company, plan routes and grow your network across a highly detailed European-inspired city.

Real Trams. Real Physics. Real Sound.

Step into the driver’s cabin of Europe’s most iconic real-world trams, with unmatched attention to detail developed in close collaboration with real-world transport operators, making this the most authentic simulation experience to date.

Drive like a pro with:

  • Precise real-world physics

  • Authentic engine & ambient sounds

  • Interactive cockpits with controls simulated

  • Full keyboard, gamepad and joystick support

  • Full custom control mapping so you can play your way

Start your shift from the sidings or tram depot and perform authentic startup procedures before entering service. Power up and operate your vehicle with step-by-step guidance, helping you ease into the most immersive tram simulation possible. This is a dream come true for tram simulation fans.

Build Your Own Network

Designing your own tram routes has never been easier. With the in-game Line Editor and Timetable Generator, you can create fully custom tram lines across the city’s growing transport network in just a few clicks:

  • Easily create your own routes by selecting stations along your desired path

  • Use the built-in Timetable Generator to set precise intervals, pause times, start/end times, and vehicle density

  • Assign vehicles to each line and let AI trams follow your schedule in real time, just like a real network

  • Monitor and optimize performance as your lines grow and adapt with the city’s needs

Career or Sandbox – Play Your Way

👨‍💼 Career Mode

Begin your journey as a small tram operator with limited resources. Transport passengers, plan routes, maintain timetables, and earn XP to level up. Receive resources to create new lines, buy vehicles and unlock upgrades. Drive with precision and stay on time to increase passenger satisfaction and expand your network across the city.

🎮 Sandbox Mode

No stress. No rules. Just freedom.

Choose from up to 7 pre-made tram lines or build your own.
Drive any vehicle, set your environment, and explore the city at your own pace.

Make It Yours – Deep Customization

You’re not just a tram driver — you’re the boss.

  • Name your operation, city, stations, and routes

  • Choose from 10 liveries and 50+ logos

  • Pick between fictional and real-world station designs

  • Your branding appears on trams, buildings, signage, and station announcements

  • Station announcements are automatically generated, support multiple languages, and include through-line integration

  • Station styles, routes, line colors, naming — fully up to you

AI trams operate on your scheduled lines, running alongside your own vehicles in real time.

A Living, Breathing City

Navigate over 25km of routes and many unique stations in a richly detailed public transport network inspired by real cities in southern Germany. Drive through bustling open-world city centers, quiet suburbs, and scenic old towns — all with a full day/night cycle, dynamic passenger volumes, intelligent and licensed AI vehicles including Deutsche Bahn trains, DHL delivery vans, and stores like REWE, Tegut, Deutsche Post and more.

Play Your Way

Whether you’re a hardcore simulation enthusiast or a casual player, City Transport Simulator: Tram has you covered:

  • Simulation Mode with full control over every button and system accurately modeled

  • Easy Mode for relaxed driving and helpful tools

  • Keyboard & Mouse, Full Gamepad, and Joystick support

  • Fully customizable controls, including custom layouts for every input device

Seamless Integration with City Transport Simulator: Bus

City Transport Simulator: Tram is a full standalone experience built on the same powerful platform as City Transport Simulator: Bus. While each title offers a complete public transport simulation on its own, owning both unlocks something even greater.

Experience a connected city, where trams and buses operate side by side in one shared world. Switch between vehicle types seamlessly, follow coordinated timetables, and run an interlinked network from one dynamic menu.

This is more than just another tram simulation — it's part of a modular simulator system that grows with you.

Built for Long-Term Support

City Transport Simulator: Tram is a deep, customizable simulation of public transport, made by enthusiasts for enthusiasts — and it’s only getting bigger. With ongoing updates, new vehicles, new cities, and more on the way.

Are you ready to take control of the city?
